task_prompt: Insert the battery into the battery holder.
task_summary: The right hand picks up the single AA battery, carries it to the black battery holder and presses it down into an empty slot against the slot's spring contact; the left hand then steadies the holder while the right hand presses and rolls the battery until it is seated.

environment.camera: fixed camera above the operator looking down the table

objects.name: AA battery

appearance.body: cylindrical cell, dark body with a metallic end

properties: A small rigid cylinder picked up with a fingertip pinch and carried in one hand.
It goes into a slot of the holder lengthwise: one end is pushed against the slot's spring contact to compress it, then the other end is pressed down so the cell drops between the contacts and seats.
Once seated it is held by the spring and stays in the slot without support.
objects.initial_state: lying on the cloth to the right of the holder
objects.final_state: seated in one slot of the holder
objects.evidence: prompt: 'battery'; 3.7 to 4.3 s the right hand pinches and lifts it; 5 to 6.2 s it is placed into a slot; 6 to 13.5 s it is pressed and seated.

objects.name: black battery holder with wires

appearance.case: black plastic, three parallel slots open on top
appearance.spring_contacts: metal coil spring at one end of each slot, flat contact at the other
appearance.wire_leads: red and black wires leaving one side

objects.approximate_size: about three AA cells side by side
properties: A rigid open-topped case with three parallel cylindrical slots, each sized for one AA cell.
Each slot has a compressible spring contact at one end: inserting a cell compresses the spring a few millimetres, and the spring then clamps the seated cell between the contacts.
The holder is light and slides when pushed, so one hand steadies it while the other presses the cell in.
Two wire leads trail from the case onto the cloth; they do not take part in the task.

articulation.range_observed: a few millimetres of spring compression during insertion
articulation.state_over_video: springs at rest -> one compressed while the cell is pushed in -> clamping the seated cell

objects.initial_state: lying on the cloth left of centre, all slots empty
objects.final_state: in about the same place, one slot holding the battery
objects.evidence: prompt: 'battery holder'; the black case with wires is visible in every frame; 9.8 to 13.5 s the left hand holds it while the right hand presses the cell in.

hand_roles.left: Rests on the table at the left.
hand_roles.right: Pinches the cell between thumb and fingers and lifts it.

subgoals.goal: The AA battery is held clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry the battery over an empty slot of the holder.

hand_roles.right: Moves the cell to above the holder, aligned with a slot.

subgoals.goal: The AA battery is above the opening of the slots and is roughly parallel to the slots.

subgoals.action: Push one end of the battery against the spring and lower it into the slot.

hand_roles.left: Rests, then comes in to steady the holder.
hand_roles.right: Presses the cell endwise into the spring and pushes the other end down into the slot.

subgoals.goal: The AA battery is inside the slots and touches the spring contacts.

subgoals.action: Steady the holder and press the battery until it is fully seated.

hand_roles.left: Holds the holder down on the cloth so it cannot slide.
hand_roles.right: Presses and rolls the cell down into the slot.

subgoals.goal: The AA battery is fully inside the slots when the hands withdraw.
The battery holder rests on the table without hand support and the AA battery is fully inside the slots when the hands withdraw.

task_success: The AA battery is fully inside the slots and touches the spring contacts, and the battery holder rests on the table.
notes: The holder has three slots; only one cell is inserted in this demonstration.
